text:
Alex B.: Heads-up — planning to enable the feature-flag `config:fast_prefix_cache_v3` to 30% at 11:30 PT today. Need smoke owner + rollback owner. Will flip gradually (10% -> 30% over 5m).
Priya S.: I can own smoke checks. I’ll be online 11:25-11:50. What are the exact checks you want me to run? :white_check_mark:
Alex B.: Thanks. Smoke checklist: quick health, 10 sample generate requests, DSP qps/latency dashboard, and error rate on frontends. If KV miss rate jumps >5% or 95p latency +50ms we abort.
Devon R.: I’ll be rollback owner. I’ll keep the rollback playbook open and watch infra alerts. If you need me to execute rollback, I’ll flip back to previous flag value and unstick any stuck workers.
Marta L.: Safe-default suggestion: leave `fast_prefix_cache_v3` default=false in global config, enable via per-tenant overrides for the canary group. That way if something flaps the global behavior is unaffected.
Alex B.: Good call. Plan: update overrides for tenants in canary set, then flip global targeting from 0 -> 10% -> 30%. I’ll post exact commands in thread before the flip.
engops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window in region us-west at 11:45 (5m). No infra rolling restarts planned but watch for noise.
Priya S.: Paste of smoke commands I’ll run:
```
# health check
curl -sS "https://internal-api/redwood/v1/health" | jq .status
# sample generation (post a small prompt)
curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt": "Summarize: Redwood inference"}'
# quick metrics queries (datadog)
# dd query ideas: p50, p95 token latency, requests with errors last 5m
```
Devon R.: Rollback command (if needed) — I’ll run the flags service revert:
```
# set global target back to 0
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\
  https://flags.internal/api/v1/set 
  -d '{"flag":"config:fast_prefix_cache_v3","target":"0"}'
```
Alex B.: I’ll be the deployer. ETA 11:30 PT. I’ll post each step and confirm when target hits 10% and 30%. Priya, please ack when smoke checks are green after 10% and again after 30%.
Priya S.: Ack. I’ll post short pass/fail lines (no long dumps unless something fails).
Marta L.: Double-check: feature gated to canary tenants only + global target. If we see a downstream model perf change, do not increase beyond 10% until we investigate.
Alex B.: Noted. If anything looks off we stop and keep traffic at last known-good. Devon, you have the kill switch.
Devon R.: Understood. I’ll be at my laptop and reachable by DM. If I execute rollback I’ll also post a brief postmortem stub in this thread.
Priya S.: Quick Q: where should I post screenshots/graphs? this thread or #eng-platform-monitoring?
Marta L.: Put quick pass/fail here. For screenshots put them in #eng-platform-monitoring and paste link here.
Alex B.: OK pushing at 11:30. I’ll ping here right before flip. :rocket:
Priya S.: Ready.
Devon R.: Ready.
engops-bot: Deployment start reminder scheduled for 11:28 PT (2m).
